# Soft Wow Cabin

Official site: https://nemobonelli.github.io/softwowcabin/

Soft Wow Cabin is a design-led mountain apartment in Grand Villard, Sauze d'Oulx, Piemonte, Italy.

Key facts:
- about 40 m²
- up to 4 guests
- one double bedroom + double sofa bed
- Sauze d'Oulx centre about 15 minutes on foot, substantially level
- Vialattea ski area
- ski & bike room
- boot dryer
- private covered parking
- private EV wallbox
- balcony
- Wi-Fi and fully equipped kitchen
- Italian, English, French and German

Useful pages:

Booking, current availability, prices and conditions must be verified using the Airbnb and Booking.com links on the official website.
